title: Experienced apprentice Dart assignment replay with ChatGPT
summary: Final-year software engineering degree apprentices use ChatGPT to repeat an earlier programming assignment in the relatively uncommon Dart language. They work toward a correctly running program and assess the substantial modifications needed to make the generated output usable.

sources.title: Generative AI in Software Development Education: Insights from a Degree Apprenticeship Programme
sources.evidence_quote: The experienced programmers were required to generate code in a relatively uncommon language (Dart) in order to complicate the task for ChatGPT

assessment.summary: Repeat an earlier programming assignment in Dart using ChatGPT and produce a correctly running program.
student_actions: Prompt ChatGPT to solve a prior assignment in Dart.
Modify the generated code until it runs correctly.
Evaluate useful and problematic aspects of the output.
